column1: # Hand-run (unmanaged) units for the dispatch final-v1 dashboard.
# These are pods a human launched by hand: no supervisor, no queue row and no
# entry in any pods*.txt ledger, so discover_campaigns() cannot see them and
# the dashboard used to render them as nothing at all (or, for the dfv1-named
# ones, as an UNCLAIMED-pod alarm).  One of them (GLM) also spans two RunPod
# accounts, which a single campaign -> single account mapping cannot express.
# Hence this file rather than a fake campaign: adding a unit is one line here.
# STRICTLY DECLARATIVE.  The dashboard only ever reads it, and only ever uses
# it to (a) name the unit and (b) decide which host to ssh to for a read-only
# tail.  Nothing here can cause a write anywhere.
# Schema: 7 tab-separated fields, one unit per line; '#' starts a comment.
#   1 label          display name, e.g. "<profile>/<arm>".  ALWAYS shown in
#                    preference to the RunPod pod name -- see the note on the
#                    coin row below for why that matters.
#   2 account        which ACCOUNTS entry pays: A1 / A2 / A3.
#   3 pod_id         RunPod pod id; matched against that account's pod list to
#                    get RUNNING/stopped and $/hr.  "-" if not known.
#   4 ssh_alias      ssh host alias for the read-only probe.  "-" to skip the
#                    probe entirely (the row still renders, progress unknown).
#   5 status_log     remote path to the unit's own log.  Its newest
#                    "[timestamp] ..." line is shown as the phase line.
#                    "-" if there is none.
#   6 progress_root  remote dir searched (maxdepth 3) for the newest train.log,
#                    which yields "which stage/arm is training" plus the tqdm
#                    step/total, s/it and the latest loss.  "-" to skip.
#   7 note           free text shown beside the row.
# A missing file, a missing field, an unreachable pod or an absent log renders
# as "unknown"; it never raises and never blocks the rest of the page.
# label
